title: Core Duo #35
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long bleached blonde hair with sun-streaked highlights, a bright cheeky grin, demure and soft, sleek straight hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting — a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense acanthus scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Russian woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, long straight platinum-blonde hair, a cold, striking expression, sultry, sleek straight hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, chrome finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.

Right woman's footwear: extreme cobalt extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 landscape 8K.
